newsitem.title: USA: More U.S. airlines match TWA fare cuts.
newsitem.headline: More U.S. airlines match TWA fare cuts.

text.p: AMR Corp's American Airlines and Northwest Airlines Corp said they matched late-spring fare cuts announced Wednesday by Trans World Airlines Inc.
The airlines said they would match the sale fares in markets where they compete with TWA. US Airways Group Inc and Delta Air Lines Inc previously said they would match the fare cuts.
TWA said Wednesday it will cut some fares on U.S. routes and on flights between the United States and Toronto by at least 50 percent.
TWA also said fares to Milan, Madrid and Rome will be cut up to 35 percent.
The special fares are non-refundable. Domestic and Toronto fares are valid for travel between May 8 and June 15, while the other fares are valid between May 8 and June 30, TWA said.
The airlines' latest fare cut extends an existing sale. Airlines typically trim fares to generate demand during seasonal lulls or to get an early start to peak travel seasons, analysts said.
